title: Insights into Allosteric Mechanisms of the Lung-Enriched p53 Mutants V157F and R158L.
authors: Lei, Jiangtao; Li, Xuanyao; Cai, Mengqiang; Guo, Tianjing; Lin, Dongdong; Deng, Xiaohua; Li, Yin
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究肺癌相关p53突变体V157F/R158L的构象动态与别构机制，虽聚焦蛋白自身折叠而非TF-DNA结合，但p53为转录因子且MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Lung cancer is a leading fatal malignancy in humans. p53 mutants exhibit not only loss of tumor suppressor capability but also oncogenic gain-of-function, contributing to lung cancer initiation, progression and therapeutic resistance. Research shows that p53 mutants V157F and R158L occur with high frequency in lung squamous cell carcinomas. Revealing their conformational dynamics is critical for developing novel lung therapies. Here, we used all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the effect of V157F and R158L substitutions on the structural properties of the p53 core domain (p53C). Compared to wild-type (WT) p53C, both V157F and R158L mutants display slightly lesser beta-sheet structure, larger radius of gyration, larger volume and larger exposed surface area, showing aggregation-prone structural characteristics. The aggregation-prone fragments (residues 249-267 and 268-282) of two mutants are more exposed to water solution than that of WT p53C. V157F and R158L mutation sites can affect the conformation switch of loop 1 through long-range associations. Simulations also reveal that the local structure and conformation around the V157F and R158L mutation sites are in a dynamic equilibrium between the misfolded and properly folded conformations. These results provide molecular mechanistic insights into allosteric mechanisms of the lung-enriched p53 mutants.
abstract_zh: 肺癌是人类一种主要的致命恶性肿瘤。p53突变体不仅丧失肿瘤抑制功能，还获得致癌性功能增益，促进肺癌的发生、进展和治疗耐药性。研究表明，p53突变体V157F和R158L在肺鳞状细胞癌中高频出现。揭示其构象动态对于开发新型肺癌疗法至关重要。在此，我们使用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟研究V157F和R158L替换对p53核心结构域 (p53C) 结构特性的影响。与野生型 (wild-type, WT) p53C相比，V157F和R158L突变体均表现出略少的β-折叠结构、更大的回旋半径、更大的体积和更大的暴露表面积，显示出易于聚集的结构特征。两个突变体的聚集倾向片段（残基249-267和268-282）比WT p53C更暴露于水溶液中。V157F和R158L突变位点可通过长程关联影响环1的构象转换。模拟还揭示，V157F和R158L突变位点周围的局部结构和构象在错误折叠与正确折叠构象之间处于动态平衡。这些结果为肺富集p53突变体的变构机制提供了分子机制见解。
